name: Zimri
bio: Zimri commanded half of King Elah's chariots. While Elah was getting drunk at the home of his palace steward in Tirzah, Zimri struck him down and killed him, seizing the throne for himself and immediately exterminating Baasha's entire family, down to the last male relative and friend — fulfilling the LORD's judgment spoken against Baasha's house through the prophet Jehu (1 Kings 16:9-13). Zimri's reign lasted only seven days: when the army, encamped against Gibbethon, heard he had murdered the king, they made their commander Omri king on the spot. Omri marched on Tirzah and besieged it; when Zimri saw the city was about to fall, he went into the citadel of the royal palace, set it on fire around himself, and died in the flames — a death Scripture attributes directly to his sins, walking in the way of Jeroboam and leading Israel into sin (1 Kings 16:15-20).
